items.t: Financial AI startup Casap raises $56 million to help banks fight a surge in fraud
items.s: Casap pulled in $56 million to expand AI tools that help banks handle disputes and stop rising customer fraud.

items.t: The AI payoff is real, but the timeline is the problem
items.s: Fortune argues AI's returns are arriving more slowly than the spending, a tension Anthropic's IPO will put to the test.

items.t: Law firm that handled Lehman and Enron bankruptcies plans to wind down
items.s: A storied restructuring law firm behind some of the largest US bankruptcies says it will close, a notable shake-up in the legal services market.

items.t: What Robinhood's CFO found interesting in Anthropic's IPO prospectus
items.s: Robinhood's finance chief walks through the details in Anthropic's filing that stood out ahead of its expected mid-November listing.

items.t: US natural gas production hits new records as demand surges
items.s: American gas output keeps setting highs as LNG exports and power demand from data centers pull on supply.

items.t: C.H. Robinson and Landstar shares slammed as insurance costs weigh
items.s: Freight brokers C.H. Robinson and Landstar sold off after results, with rising insurance costs among the pressures on trucking margins.

items.t: Aurora adds 500-truck Charger deal toward its 30,000-truck goal
items.s: Autonomous trucking firm Aurora signed a memorandum with carrier Charger for 500 driverless trucks as it builds toward a 30,000-truck target.

items.t: Bessent plays down concerns over AI financing and Fed rate policy
items.s: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent brushed off worries about debt-fueled AI buildouts and the Fed's decision to hold rates steady.

items.t: Upwind raises $400 million after walking away from Datadog's acquisition offer
items.s: Cloud security startup Upwind chose a $400 million funding round over selling to Datadog, betting on staying independent.

items.t: Investors eye Brazilian equities after post-election selloff
items.s: After markets slumped on Lula's surprise win, some investors see the drop in Brazilian stocks as a buying opportunity.

items.t: CBO projects $20 trillion in federal interest costs over the next decade
items.s: The Congressional Budget Office's new outlook has Treasury interest payments on the national debt topping $20 trillion over ten years.

items.t: UK Treasury offers energy bill relief and a one-off payment amid Iran war shock
items.s: Britain is rolling out household energy-bill support and a one-time payment as the Iran war keeps fuel and power prices high.

items.t: Airbnb drops some guest cleaning chores, and hosts threaten a boycott
items.s: Airbnb told guests they no longer have to do certain cleanup tasks, angering hosts who say it pushes cleaning costs onto them.

items.t: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
items.s: Microsoft's latest quarterly results show roughly $10 billion of revenue tied to OpenAI, underscoring how central the startup's compute demand has become to Azure's growth.

items.t: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
items.s: Google is rolling out ads inside its AI-powered search experiences worldwide as growth in its traditional search advertising business cools.

items.t: Alphabet slips as Google Cloud revenue doubles but free cash flow turns negative
items.s: Google Cloud sales roughly doubled to about $31 billion, yet heavy AI infrastructure spending pushed Alphabet's free cash flow below zero and weighed on the stock.

items.t: Microsoft's cloud growth accelerates, and so does its spending
items.s: Microsoft reported faster Azure-driven cloud growth alongside a further jump in capital spending on AI data centers.

items.t: SK Hynix expects the memory-chip shortage to last until 2030
items.s: The chipmaker says more than half of its output is already booked for the next two years as AI demand keeps memory supply tight.

items.t: Dollar falls after Fed holds rates steady
items.s: The U.S. dollar weakened after the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged at its October meeting.

items.t: Warsh bats away midterm politics questions after rate decision
items.s: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said politics never came up in the committee's deliberations as the central bank held rates days before the midterm elections.

items.t: Anthropic launches tools to show companies what their AI spending buys
items.s: New Anthropic tools aim to help businesses measure the return on their AI usage and spending across teams.

items.t: Kodiak lands first commercial deal to supply driverless trucks for public highways
items.s: Autonomous trucking firm Kodiak signed its first commercial agreement to deliver self-driving trucks that will run on public highways.

items.t: Hacker steals personnel data on thousands of Homeland Security employees
items.s: A breach exposed personnel records for thousands of DHS staff, including CBP and ICE agents.

items.t: Fed holds rates steady as a governor and a regional president dissent together for the first time since 1992
items.s: The Fed kept rates unchanged under Chair Kevin Warsh, but two officials broke ranks in favor of a hike, a rare joint dissent that signals pressure to tighten further.

items.t: FTC and 20 states sue Dollar General over alleged shelf-price overcharging
items.s: Regulators accuse the discount chain of charging low-income shoppers more at the register than the prices posted on its shelves.

items.t: The Fed just removed a 2027 rate decision, raising the stakes for the remaining seven
items.s: The Fed trimmed its 2027 meeting calendar to seven sessions, meaning each remaining decision carries more weight for borrowing costs and markets.

items.t: Oil prices rise on Yemen fighting and an attack on a Saudi refinery
items.s: Crude climbed as new fighting in Yemen and a strike on Saudi refining capacity added to supply worries already elevated by the Iran war.

items.t: Canada reports limited progress in trade talks with the US
items.s: Canadian officials say negotiations with Washington have made only modest headway, leaving tariff uncertainty in place for cross-border businesses.

items.t: Italy approves 2027 budget with tax hikes on banks and energy firms
items.s: Rome's new budget leans on higher levies on lenders and energy companies to fund its spending plans.

items.t: Phillips 66 posts record $5.6 billion profit as refining margins soar
items.s: The refiner's quarterly profit hit a record as war-driven fuel shortages widened the gap between crude costs and product prices.

items.t: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips as it looks beyond Nvidia
items.s: OpenAI is reportedly lining up purchases of Google's TPUs to diversify its compute supply away from Nvidia.

items.t: Some BP board members favor breaking up the $129 billion oil giant
items.s: A faction of BP's board is said to back splitting the company as pressure mounts to unlock value from its oil, gas and low-carbon businesses.

items.t: Chrome's AI-powered Autofill can now pull from Gmail to fill out forms
items.s: Google is letting Chrome's AI autofill draw on users' Gmail data to complete web forms, extending its agentic browser features.

items.t: Apple unveils $2,899 MacBook Pro, its first touchscreen laptop
items.s: Apple added touch input to its pro laptop line at a premium price, a shift for a company that long resisted touchscreen Macs.

items.t: Microsoft reports Q1 results as Wall Street watches Azure growth
items.s: Investors are looking to Microsoft's cloud growth to justify its heavy AI infrastructure spending as it reports fiscal first-quarter earnings.

items.t: SpaceX stock slides back toward $140 as smaller space names leave it behind
items.s: SpaceX shares gave back recent gains while smaller space stocks kept rallying.

items.t: Midwest gasoline supplies hit lowest on record as election nears
items.s: Gasoline inventories in the US Midwest fell to a record low, raising the risk of regional price spikes days before the midterms.

items.t: Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps as AI agents reshape the web
items.s: Google is letting more third-party apps plug into Gemini and Search, betting on agents that act across services for users.

items.t: Reddit adopts a 'For You' feed in its latest platform shift
items.s: Reddit is rolling out an algorithmic 'For You' feed, following other social platforms in recommending content beyond the communities users follow.

items.t: S&P 500 nears record high as AI chip stocks rally
items.s: Broadcom and Nvidia led a climb that pushed the S&P 500 toward an all-time high ahead of the Fed decision and Big Tech earnings.

items.t: Malaysia intercepts $12.2 million shipment of AI-chip servers over export-control concerns
items.s: Malaysian authorities seized servers carrying advanced AI chips suspected of being routed to China in breach of US export controls.

items.t: Airbus holds annual targets, bets on year-end delivery surge
items.s: Airbus kept its full-year delivery and profit goals, counting on a heavy fourth-quarter push despite ongoing supply constraints.

items.t: Mexico and US assess viability of trade deal before midterms
items.s: Officials from both countries are weighing whether a trade agreement can be reached ahead of the US midterm elections.

items.t: From Texas to Ohio, the data center backlash is spilling into the midterms
items.s: Local opposition to power-hungry AI data centers over electricity costs and land use is becoming a campaign issue in several states.

items.t: US consumers look resilient despite higher prices for gas and Halloween candy
items.s: Spending is holding up even as shoppers face steeper prices on fuel, candy and other seasonal goods.

items.t: DOE lends $5 billion to nuclear plants that will power data centers
items.s: The Energy Department is financing nuclear projects meant to supply electricity for AI data center demand.

items.t: Virginia lender First Community expands into Ohio with $243M deal
items.s: First Community agreed to a $243 million bank acquisition that extends its footprint into Ohio amid a pickup in regional bank M&A.

items.t: Wall Street choppy as megacap losses offset chip gains ahead of Fed decision
items.s: Stocks traded mixed as declines in the biggest tech names countered a rally in chipmakers, with investors waiting on the Fed's afternoon rate decision.

items.t: AI giants' funding ambitions test investors' appetite for risk
items.s: The scale of capital the largest AI companies are seeking is pushing investors to weigh how much risk they are willing to take on the sector.

items.t: SAP swaps costly AI models for cheaper ones, targeting over €2 billion in savings
items.s: SAP is replacing expensive AI models with lower-cost alternatives as part of a push to cut more than €2 billion in costs.

items.t: GE Vernova to buy high-voltage grid equipment maker for about $9 billion
items.s: GE Vernova agreed to a roughly $9 billion acquisition of a grid-equipment maker as power demand from data centers strains the electric grid.

items.t: Nvidia forges supplier agreements to expand AI chip capacity
items.s: Nvidia struck new deals with suppliers aimed at increasing production capacity for its AI chips amid persistent compute shortages.

items.t: Natural gas emerges as a key AI bottleneck, Anthropic's S-1 filing shows
items.s: Anthropic's IPO filing points to natural gas supply for power generation as a growing constraint on AI data center expansion.

items.t: Rail backlog grows to 35,000 containers at Los Angeles–Long Beach
items.s: A buildup of roughly 35,000 containers awaiting rail at the Southern California ports is adding delays for importers.

items.t: America's truckers on the brink with 221 bankruptcies so far this year
items.s: US trucking companies are under mounting financial strain, with 221 bankruptcy filings recorded so far in 2026.

items.t: Cif maker warns cleaning product prices will rise as Iran war drags on
items.s: The maker of Cif said household cleaning products will get more expensive as the Iran war keeps pushing up input and energy costs.

items.t: World Bank sees commodity prices up 23% in 2026 on Middle East war and other shocks
items.s: The World Bank expects commodity prices to rise 23% this year, driven largely by energy disruptions from the Middle East conflict.

items.t: Nelson Peltz makes buyout offer for struggling Wendy's
items.s: Activist investor Nelson Peltz has offered to take the burger chain private as Wendy's struggles with weak sales.

items.t: Boston Scientific falls as August cyberattack dents sales
items.s: Boston Scientific shares dropped after the company said a cyberattack in August hurt quarterly sales.

items.t: Wealthsimple raises funds at a $9.8 billion valuation
items.s: Canadian fintech Wealthsimple closed a new funding round that values it at $9.8 billion.

items.t: Anthropic's tensions with the Trump administration laid bare ahead of IPO
items.s: Anthropic's IPO filing details friction with the White House over AI policy, a risk investors will weigh ahead of the listing.

items.t: Vertiv stock surges as orders double on the AI data center build-out
items.s: Data center equipment maker Vertiv said orders doubled as AI infrastructure spending accelerates, sending its shares higher.

items.t: Diesel prices may stay elevated into spring 2027, fuel executives warn
items.s: Fuel industry executives expect tight distillate supply to keep diesel prices high for months, raising costs for truckers and shippers.

items.t: Big Law faces its reckoning
items.s: The collapse of Weil has rattled other big corporate law firms, which now worry about their own partner retention and finances.

items.t: Wall Street's AI debt machine is running short on supply
items.s: Lenders financing the AI data center buildout are finding fewer deals and investors to absorb the borrowing, testing the credit-fueled boom.

items.t: Jake Paul backs a project to revive US titanium sponge production
items.s: The project aims to restart domestic output of titanium sponge, a key aerospace and defense input the US now imports.

items.t: RXO founder Brad Jacobs backs C.H. Robinson's acquisition of RXO
items.s: The freight brokerage's creator is supporting the proposed deal that would combine two of the largest US truckload brokers.

items.t: China's wind and solar capacity passes 2 terawatts
items.s: China's installed wind and solar generation has topped 2 TW, widening its lead in renewable buildout.

items.t: South Korea fines Google and Apple over unfair app market practices
items.s: South Korean regulators penalized both companies over app store practices they said disadvantaged developers.

items.t: BNP Paribas downplays French debt exposure as stock trading lifts profit
items.s: France's largest bank posted higher profit on strong equity trading and sought to calm concern over its holdings of French government debt.

items.t: Coinbase customer data exposed in analytics vendor breach
items.s: Coinbase said a breach at a third-party analytics provider exposed some customer data but did not affect funds.

items.t: Equinor profits triple as oil and gas prices surge
items.s: Norway's Equinor reported sharply higher quarterly profit on elevated energy prices tied to Middle East supply risk.

items.t: FTC flexes its muscles on $5 billion uniform deal
items.s: The FTC is pushing back on a $5 billion merger in the workplace-uniform industry, a sign of tougher antitrust scrutiny for service-provider consolidation.

items.t: US consumer confidence ticks up in October
items.s: The Conference Board's consumer confidence gauge rose modestly in October despite higher gas prices and persistent inflation worries.

items.t: Microsoft's buyout offer to employees shows which tech jobs matter
items.s: Microsoft's voluntary buyouts for roughly 60,000 workers signal which roles the company sees as less essential as it shifts resources to AI.

items.t: Anthropic's IPO needs believers to bridge it to the payoff
items.s: Anthropic's listing will hinge on investors accepting years of heavy spending before its AI business delivers profits.

items.t: Hasbro's AI play: an AI-generated Mr. Potato Head voiced by Don Rickles
items.s: Hasbro is using generative AI to recreate the late comedian's voice for Mr. Potato Head as part of a broader push into AI products.

items.t: Werner Enterprises sees cost headwinds lingering into Q1
items.s: The truckload carrier told investors elevated operating costs, including record diesel prices, will keep pressuring margins into early next year.

items.t: The Fed says it ignores politics. Its rate moves tell a more complicated story
items.s: Ahead of this week's FOMC decision, CNN examines how the Fed's rate path has lined up with political pressure despite its claims of independence.

items.t: China's stock market has lost $2.4 trillion as investors doubt its AI boom will pay off
items.s: Chinese equities have shed trillions in value as investors question whether heavy AI spending there will produce returns.

excl.s: Big Tech earnings and Anthropic's mid-November IPO will test investor appetite for AI; Ramp data shows a record 8% of firms switched AI providers in September.
New Ramp data shows AI spend growth slowed sharply over the past two months; Ramp's economist points to falling prices for frontier models.
Total AI spend on Ramp is falling even as token volumes rise, as OpenAI and Anthropic compete on price. Top-1% spend per employee fell nearly 10% from July to August.
